prompts.debuffs: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D VFX sprite sheet for AshenSpire, hand-painted faceted dark fantasy matching restrained six-frame game effects. EXACTLY 24 isolated sprites in FOUR ROWS by SIX EQUAL COLUMNS on a wide 3:2 canvas. Each row is one six-frame animation: tiny anticipation, gather, release, peak, dispersal, faint remnants. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, scene, text, labels, bodies or borders. Every sprite centered at identical scale, only central 60 percent of its cell, generous empty transparent gutters on all sides. Compact readable shapes and hollow centers, no tall columns crossing slots. Row1 INSANITY: violet broken spiral twisting into jagged violet mind-fracture shards. Row2 CRIMSON BLIGHT: red-black creeping thorn-like veins and sparse rusty red spores, clearly distinct from green poison. Row3 WEAK: desaturated gray wisps drooping downward, faint broken downward chevron. Row4 VULNERABLE: amber thin fractured diamond opening outward, exposed stress cracks, tiny shards.
